To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

it is possible, using a language independent text representation, to obtain good performance in cross language classification tasks, and that it is possible even in the case when no labeled data is available for the target language.

(1) it is possible to train a language independent encoder that gives almost identical representations to texts written in different languages, and (2) the encoder can be used to transfer labels between languages.

we can achieve good results on zero-shot cross language text classification tasks by training a language independent text encoding model on a comparable corpus and using it to obtain a shared text representation for all languages.
